rawFindings.title: Potential conflict when adding version key field to schema dynamically
rawFindings.explanation: The patch adds the version key field to the schema via schema.add() dynamically if versioning is enabled and the version key path does not exist. This can cause issues if a property with the same name exists in an embedded schema or with default values, as only top-level documents should have the version key field. The schema.add call modifies the schema globally which could affect embedded schemas or subdocuments unexpectedly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Ensure the version key field is only added to the top-level schema and not to nested schemas by more precisely scoping the schema addition or checking schema depth before adding the version key.
